intended_claim: G128 simultaneously improves common SL256, natural-start LOO B128, and continued-SL C128 frozen greedy+sameH complete routes on the fixed new development tasks.
confidence_scope: Rejection of this fixed single-seed development-screen claim; not a universal DRL or cross-seed conclusion.
what_results_support: One registered seed11622026 G128 run completed128 updates and2480 requests within989.3444799s. Direct recomputation of432 saved results on72 new views over12 trained physical layouts reproduces parent-averaged H-final gains versus SL/B/C of -2.8641351%/-2.4678596%/-3.2426334%, with95% bootstrap intervals strictly negative. All432 result artifacts are valid and finite and match CSV SHA256. H lowers G's own raw mean J by25.8719397199, but the trained G policy loses to every primary control before and after H. The reference adds512 requests,33.3333% relative to1536 sample training requests.
what_results_dont_support: G does not improve SL256 or outperform B128/C128 in either registered raw or H-final average gain. The candidate does not pass the predeclared AND screen or warrant direct multiple-seed confirmation as a successful recipe. The evidence does not establish reduced gradient variance, a causal explanation for degradation, unseen-layout generalization, optimization-seed robustness, deployment latency advantage, real-arm/IK certification, or DRL's general ineffectiveness. Toy engineering PASS and expected-score baseline invariance do not imply monotonic greedy improvement.
